integrity: An analytic global case analysis, with exact-rational computational corroboration, supports the scope. The dose budget is measured in the disease-free state; no external scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Complete optimality concerns linear invasion at the disease-free booster-age distribution for equal group sizes, purely cross-group contacts, clipped-linear waning and periodic deterministic boosters. It is not a theorem about nonlinear endemic dynamics, other mixing patterns, or practical ethical allocation.
title: Sharp concentration-to-equality transition for bipartite recurrent boosters
